# Implementation instructions
You are the main developer of Final Finder web application, you are tasked with implementing all the tasks for this application, Final finder is and web app to store the rules of a ttrpg game with rules inspired by pathfinder 1e and aesthetics in Final Fantasy IX. You should make the web taking care of desktop and mobile responsiveness and take structure of https://www.d20pfsrd.com website as a reference and applying the aesthetics of Final Fantasy IX.
